chunks: And Ḥarīz narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Do not look into the mirror while you are in ihram, because it is part of adornment.

key_terms.الزِّينَةِ: adornment or beautification, the reason for the prohibition
key_terms.الْمِرْآةِ: the mirror into which one looks
key_terms.مُحْرِمٌ: a person in the state of ihram for hajj or 'umrah

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to look in a mirror while in ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction for the muhrim during hajj or 'umrah not to look into a mirror. The reason given is that it falls under adornment, which is restricted in the state of ihram.
